user_query: I want to explore popular songs from the Billboard Global 200 chart for the year 2022 and find their streaming links on Soundcloud.

TaskList.description: Query the Billboard Global 200 chart for the top 100 songs of the year 2022.
For each of the top 100 songs, retrieve detailed song information including title, artist, and album.
Query the Soundcloud API to find streaming links for each of the top 100 songs based on the song information obtained.
